result:
Both Memo and User are tied at 6 packages each. Now let me compile the final answers.

Here are the answers to all 20 questions:

---

**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours — `server/server.go:153` (`startBackgroundRunners`, called from `Start` at line 129; runner created at line 162, initial `RunOnce` at line 163, ticker loop launched at line 167)

**h02** — delivery function: `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (async delivery via `PostAsync` at line 184, consumed by goroutine workers started in `init()` at lines 42-55); protection mechanism: `safeDialContext` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59` resolves the hostname and rejects reserved/private IPs via `isReservedIP` + `reservedCIDRs` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54`

**h03** — abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` at `internal/idp/idp.go:3-8`); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 `IdentityProvider` at `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20`)

**h04** — No; the MySQL driver (`mysql.DB` defined at `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:14`) is never constructed outside the factory. Its constructor `mysql.NewDB` is only called at `store/db/db.go:22`. Grepping the entire codebase for `mysql.NewDB` and imports of the `store/db/mysql` package outside `store/db/db.go` and the `store/db/mysql/` directory itself returns zero results.

**h05** — Explicit Go code; evidence: `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96` calls `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (deletes reactions on the user's memos, line 417-425) and line 102 calls `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (deletes reactions created by the user, line 437-439). The reaction table has no FOREIGN KEY constraints at all — verified in `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:90-98` and the sqlite/postgres equivalents. Same pattern exists in the sqlite and postgres user_delete implementations.

**h06** — Handlers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), `UpdateMemo` (`:401`), `DeleteMemo` (`:518`), `CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go:20`), `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:16`), `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:16`); convergence function: `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`

**h07** —
- `serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `driver.ListUsers` (concrete e.g. sqlite) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go` (dispatched via `Driver` interface)
- `parseDataURI` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737` (decodes base64 data URI to raw image bytes)

**h08** —
- `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — not invoked from production code — (no caller)
- `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) — invoked — callers: `server/server.go:163` and self-call at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`

**h09** — 6 distinct declarations: `Cache.Close` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:72`), `SSEHub.Close` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`), `postgres.DB.Close` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), `sqlite.DB.Close` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `mysql.DB.Close` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`). All are reachable from production code: `Store.Close` called at `server/server.go:146`; inside it, `Cache.Close` called 3 times at `store/store.go:74-76` and `driver.Close` at `store/store.go:78` (dispatches to whichever DB driver is active); `SSEHub.Close` called at `server/server.go:206`.

**h10** — `util.GenUUID` — `internal/util/util.go:40` — approx fan-in ~7 production call sites (28 including tests). Runner-up `filter.DefaultEngine` at `internal/filter/engine.go:111` also has 7 production call sites.

**h11** — 1st: Memo (~6 packages: server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/fileserver, server/router/frontend, server/router/rss, server/runner/memopayload); 2nd: User (~6 packages: server/auth, server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/api/v1/test, server/router/fileserver, server/router/rss). Effectively tied; Attachment is 3rd with ~3 packages.

**h12** — `sqlite.(*DB).CreateMemo` at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (INSERT at line 41-42); determination: `cmd/memos/main.go:122` sets `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`, `store/db/db.go:18-20` switches on that value to construct `sqlite.NewDB`, and `store/memo.go:113` dispatches through the `Driver` interface to the sqlite implementation.

**h13** — impl: unexported `service` struct at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`; construction: `markdown.NewService()` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`, called in production by `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`; holders: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`)

**h14** — computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, calling `markdownService.ExtractAll` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`; triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` with content change (`:447`), batch `RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`); extracted properties: `HasLink`, `HasTaskList`, `HasCode`, `HasIncompleteTasks`, `Title` (from first H1), plus `Tags` and `Mentions`

**h15** —
- `checkMemoReadAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39` (used by GetMemo, ListMemoComments)
- `ListMemos` visibility filtering — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218`
- `CreateMemoComment` visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:33`
- `ListMemoAttachments`/`GetMemoAttachment` check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213`
- RSS feed filtering (PUBLIC only) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141`
- File server attachment serving — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:674`
- SSE delivery filtering (`canReceive`) — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`
- Notification visibility (`canViewerAccessMemo`) — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302`

**r01** — False premise. There is no Redis in this codebase. The cache layer is a pure in-memory Go cache using `sync.Map`, implemented at `store/cache/cache.go` and instantiated in `store/store.go:40-53` with a 10-minute TTL, 5-minute cleanup interval, and 1000 max items for all caches (userCache, userSettingCache, instanceSettingCache).

**r02** — False premise. There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware anywhere in this codebase. No rate limiting, token bucket, or throttling code exists.

**r03** — False premise. There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The scheduler infrastructure exists at `internal/scheduler/` but no jobs are registered anywhere in production code. The only background runners are `s3presign.Runner` (12-hour S3 URL refresh) and `memopayload.Runner` (batch payload rebuild).

**r04** — False premise. Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. Webhooks are delivered via direct HTTP POST from an in-process buffered Go channel (`asyncPostQueue`, capacity 128, at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) consumed by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (lines 42-55).

**r05** — False premise. There is no GraphQL API. The public API uses gRPC + gRPC-Gateway (REST/JSON) + ConnectRPC, defined via Protobuf in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` and registered at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`.
